job_spec.name: qkd_rstseq-kc1-b4a0a3156
job_spec.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 track B: the die's reset sequencer as its own small M5 leaf beside the PLL hard macro qkd_pll (decision in el1011-qwen-tp8.log). Body ot_qwen_sys_rst_seq NL 4 (3 package SerDes ports + host SerDes) ND 4 (quadrant KV services); status inputs captured at the pins, every output a flop at its pin, reset outputs replicated per consumer (rso_c / rso_fwd = die reset, rso_<q> = HBM reset, rso_host, rso_link), boot_go x4, status word to the host. 134 flops.
